title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Daniel 10: three weeks of mourning by the river Hiddekel, the man clothed in linen, and the princes of Persia and Greece.

questions.text: In the third year of which king was a thing revealed to Daniel?
questions.explanation: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar, and the thing was true.

answers.text: Belshazzar king of Babylon
Darius the Mede
Cyrus king of Persia
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

questions.text: What did Daniel do without during his three whole weeks of mourning?
questions.explanation: He ate no pleasant bread, no meat or wine came into his mouth, and he did not anoint himself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

answers.text: Pleasant bread, meat and wine, and anointing himself
All food and all drink, including water
Sleep, washing and all rest at night
Speaking with anyone during those days

questions.text: Where was Daniel on the twenty-fourth day of the first month?
questions.explanation: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month he was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel.

answers.text: By the river Ulai
In the citadel of Susa
In his house with his windows open
By the great river Hiddekel

questions.text: How was the man that Daniel saw clothed?
questions.explanation: He saw a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

answers.text: Clothed with purple and a chain of gold
Clothed in linen, with thighs adorned with pure gold of Uphaz
Clothed in white as snow, with hair like pure wool
Clothed in the king's own royal robes

questions.text: What were the man's eyes and face like?
questions.explanation: His face was as the appearance of lightning and his eyes as flaming torches, and the voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

answers.text: His face like lightning and his eyes like flaming torches
His face like pure wool and his eyes like fiery wheels
His face as the sun and his eyes like beryl
His face hidden and his eyes closed

questions.text: What happened to the men who were with Daniel?
questions.explanation: They did not see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them and they fled to hide themselves, so Daniel was left alone.

answers.text: They saw the vision and fell on their faces
They stayed and held Daniel upright
A great quaking fell on them and they fled to hide
They ran to tell the king of Persia

questions.text: How did the speaker address Daniel when he told him to understand the words and stand upright?
questions.explanation: He said, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for I have been sent to you, now.”

answers.text: As master of the magicians
As a greatly beloved man
As the third ruler in the kingdom
As a servant of the king of Persia

questions.text: How long did the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstand the speaker?
questions.explanation: He said that the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood him twenty-one days.

answers.text: Three days
Seventy days
Ten days
Twenty-one days

questions.text: Who is named as the only one who holds with the speaker against these princes?
questions.explanation: He said there is no one who holds with him against these, but Michael, Daniel's prince.

answers.text: Gabriel
The prince of Greece
Michael
The prince of the kingdom of Persia

questions.text: Whose coming did the speaker announce after saying he would return to fight the prince of Persia?
questions.explanation: He said he would return to fight with the prince of Persia, and that when he went out, the prince of Greece would come.

answers.text: The prince of Greece
The prince of the kingdom of Media
The prince of princes
Michael, one of the chief princes
